title: Safeguard door phone sleeve: washable canvas with a soft-touch silicone back, cream
bullets: Washable canvas with a soft-touch silicone back, in cream to suit most hallway doors.
Six built-in suction cups: no drilling and no adhesive, and it can be moved to another door.
Covers the screen and leaves only the top of the phone visible, so a parent can see it from the hallway.
Cable hole in the bottom for your own charger (charger not included).
Works best on smooth, non-porous doors such as gloss paint, laminate, glass or metal.

packageCard.headline: Have more than one door?
packageCard.body: Most families hang one Safeguard on every bedroom and bathroom door. The 4-pack is available only on our website, with free shipping.
